fact: Rumpadump shouts that they are home and sprints ahead.
source_quote: Rumpadump cried "We're home! We're home! We're home!" and sprinted ahead with Stool.
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Sarith walks with a quiet, peaceful expression unlike any the party had seen before.
source_quote: Sarith walked with a quiet, peaceful expression that none of the party had seen on him before.
subject: Sarith

fact: Zalthir wraps himself in a shroud of darkness because he does not trust the environment.
source_quote: Zalthir, ever cautious, wrapped himself in a shroud of darkness, explaining, "I don't trust any of these things."
subject: Zalthir

fact: Neverlight Grove is a vast cavern with bioluminescent mushrooms covering every surface and a lake at its heart.
source_quote: Neverlight Grove opened before them like a dream. It was a vast cavern where bioluminescent mushrooms covered every surface, floor to ceiling, with a lake at its heart.
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: Phylo is a sovereign of the grove who receives the party warmly.
source_quote: The two sovereigns of the grove, Phylo and Basidia, received them warmly
subject: Phylo

fact: Basidia is a sovereign of the grove who receives the party warmly.
source_quote: The two sovereigns of the grove, Phylo and Basidia, received them warmly
subject: Basidia

fact: The Great Seeder is a figure praised by Phylo who is said to be able to answer any question.
source_quote: He praised a figure called the "Great Seeder," who could answer any question
subject: Great Seeder

fact: Phylo refers to the Great Seeder using female pronouns 'she' and 'her'.
source_quote: kept calling the entity "she" and "her".
subject: Phylo

fact: Myconids have no gender.
source_quote: because myconids have no gender.
subject: myconids

fact: Basidia is observed staring at Phylo in visible discomfort.
source_quote: An insight check revealed that Basidia was staring at Phylo in visible discomfort.
subject: Basidia

fact: Basidia arranges for Phylo to stay behind and leads the tour herself.
source_quote: She arranged for Phylo to stay behind and led the tour herself.
subject: Basidia takes over tour

fact: A previous group of 'softers' accepted Phylo's hospitality and were taken to the Garden of Welcome.
source_quote: A previous group of "softers" had accepted Phylo's hospitality and been taken to the Garden of Welcome.
subject: softers

fact: The Garden of Welcome is a place where a previous group of softers was taken by Phylo.
source_quote: been taken to the Garden of Welcome.
subject: Garden of Welcome

fact: The previous group of softers has not been seen since and Phylo never mentions them again.
source_quote: She had not seen them since, and Phylo had never mentioned them again.
subject: softers disappearance

fact: The tunnel into the grove is lit by glowing lichen.
source_quote: The party enters the grove through a natural tunnel lit by glowing lichen
subject: tunnel

fact: The tunnel is the only passage fit for easy travel.
source_quote: The tunnel is the only passage fit for easy travel; the others are narrow fissures.
subject: tunnel

fact: Beyond a ravine, a mushroom tower is glimpsed through mist.
source_quote: Beyond a ravine, a mushroom tower is glimpsed through mist.
subject: ravine

fact: Gyrgum remarks that the place looks incredible, colorful, and mushroom-y.
source_quote: Gyrgum: "Wow, this place looks incredible! So colorful and mushroom-y."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The GM likens myconids to 1960s flower people who are chill, communal, and uninterested in conquest.
source_quote: The GM likens myconids to 1960s "flower people" who are chill, communal, and uninterested in conquest.
subject: GM

fact: Daz jokes that it is good the party did not bring pepperoni-mushroom pizzas.
source_quote: Daz jokes that it is a good thing the party has not brought any pepperoni-mushroom pizzas.
subject: Daz

fact: Stool sprints ahead with Rumpadump to greet the sovereigns.
source_quote: Rumpadump cried "We're home! We're home! We're home!" and sprinted ahead with Stool.
subject: Stool

fact: Gyrgum follows at a distance to watch how the sprouts interact with Phylo and Basidia.
source_quote: Gyrgum follows at a distance to watch how the sprouts interact with Phylo and Basidia.
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Daz climbs onto high ground to observe.
source_quote: Daz climbs onto high ground to observe.
subject: Daz

fact: Eldeth decides Thorin is crazy for following and stands next to Daz.
source_quote: Eldeth decides Thorin is "crazy" for following, and she stands next to Daz instead.
subject: Eldeth

fact: Thorin is referenced by Eldeth as being crazy for following.
source_quote: Eldeth decides Thorin is "crazy" for following
subject: Thorin

fact: Jimjar walks over with the group.
source_quote: Jimjar and Sarith walk over with the group.
subject: Jimjar

fact: Zalthir maintains a protective orb of darkness around himself.
source_quote: Zalthir maintains a protective orb of darkness around himself
subject: Zalthir

fact: Sovereign Phylo and Sovereign Basidia welcome the party for returning the young myconids.
source_quote: The party meets Sovereign Phylo and Sovereign Basidia, who welcome them for returning the young myconids.
subject: Phylo and Basidia welcome party

fact: Stool states that Thorin carried him when he was tired.
source_quote: Stool asks where Zalthir is and adds that "Thorin carried me when I was tired."
subject: Stool

fact: Phylo speaks of a 'day of joy' and a 'great celebration' occurring soon.
source_quote: Phylo speaks of a 'day of joy' and a 'great celebration' occurring soon
subject: Phylo

fact: Phylo offers a tour of the grove but says the Circle of Masters will be visited the following day.
source_quote: offers a tour of the grove but says the Circle of Masters will only be visited the following day.
subject: Phylo

fact: The Circle of Masters is a place in the grove that Phylo says will be visited the following day.
source_quote: says the Circle of Masters will only be visited the following day.
subject: Circle of Masters

fact: Phylo addresses the party as 'friendly softers'.
source_quote: He addresses them as "friendly softers."
subject: Phylo

fact: Sarith advises the party to stay on the sovereign's good side.
source_quote: Sarith advises staying on the sovereign's good side.
subject: Sarith

fact: Gyrgum states he plans to praise whatever the sovereign shows them.
source_quote: Gyrgum replies, "Oh, I'm planning to praise the heck out of whatever he shows us."
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Phylo describes the Great Seeder as all-knowing, wise, and able to answer any question.
source_quote: Phylo describes the Great Seeder, who lives beyond the garden, as all-knowing, wise, and able to answer any question.
subject: Phylo

fact: The Great Seeder lives beyond the garden.
source_quote: the Great Seeder, who lives beyond the garden
subject: garden

fact: Daz's Arcana/Nature check results in a 12, or 23 with help.
source_quote: Daz's Arcana/Nature check comes to 12, and 23 with help.
subject: Daz insight check

fact: Gyrgum's insight check of 18 reveals Basidia looking uncomfortable at Phylo.
source_quote: Gyrgum's insight check of 18 catches Basidia looking uncomfortable at Phylo.
subject: Gyrgum insight check

fact: Phylo affirms that Basidia is his sovereign and co-equal in all things.
source_quote: Phylo replies, "Yes, Basidia, you are my sovereign and co-equal in all things."
subject: Phylo

fact: Gyrgum and Zalthir trade jokes about 'two-in-the-box' management.
source_quote: Gyrgum and Zalthir trade jokes about "two-in-the-box" management.
subject: two-in-the-box joke
